about: Read by branch_gate.py, by the server's /api/reviews routes and by the task worker's reviews.land and branches.clean tasks. apply=false: the two tasks only report what they would do. grace_days counts from when the cleaner first saw a branch fully merged. review_timeout_hours: an open change nobody objects to is accepted after this long. delete_after_landing: the default for a submitted change (the author may ask to keep the branch). protected: branch name patterns never cleaned, in every repository; a repository may add its own.
